purpose: Running count of the Phase 2 reserve slices a study has spent. The pre-registration in verification/phase2-data-preregistration.json is a frozen snapshot of the data step and is never back-edited; this file changes instead.
rule: A study spends the reserve slice named after it, at most once. A second entry for the same slice means the slice was observed twice and its guarantee is void.

entries.note: Two non-iterated passes, one per surface, scoring one ensemble each. The pre-registered scope was the arm selected on validation plus the no-augmentation control; validation selected the control itself, so they coincided. Both surfaces are now burned for the published no-augmentation N1 ensemble.
